title: On the Limits of Sufficient Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2611.18163v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We formally characterize the conditions under which sufficient explanations exist for classifiers on structured data such as graphs and strings. We focus on post-hoc explainers that select parts of the input as sufficient explanations. An explanation is sufficient if the selected part alone ensures the predicted label. Sufficient explanations have been widely adopted across data modalities, including graphs, strings, and images. However, a unified formal analysis of sufficient explanations remains missing. We bridge this gap with four main contributions: (i) We define a general explanation formalism consisting of an instance space, a classifier, and a select relation. The select relation specifies which potential sub-instances or feature subsets can be selected as explanations from each instance; (ii) We show that the existence of sufficient explainers is fully characterized by the interplay between the classifier and the select relation

translated_abstract: 我们形式化地刻画了分类器在图和字符串等结构化数据上存在充分解释的条件。我们关注那些通过选取输入的一部分作为充分解释的事后解释器。如果所选部分本身就能保证预测标签，则该解释是充分的。充分解释已被广泛应用于图、字符串和图像等多种数据模态。然而，对充分解释的统一形式化分析仍然缺失。我们通过四项主要贡献来弥补这一空白：(i) 我们定义了一个通用的解释形式体系，由实例空间、分类器和选择关系组成，其中选择关系规定了从每个实例中可以选取哪些潜在的子实例或特征子集作为解释；(ii) 我们证明了充分解释器的存在完全由分类器与选择关系之间的相互作用所刻画。
tldr: 该论文建立了一个通用的充分解释形式化框架，并证明分类器在图和字符串等结构化数据上充分解释器的存在性完全由分类器与选择关系之间的相互作用决定。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a general formalism for sufficient explanations and proves that the existence of sufficient explainers for classifiers on structured data is fully characterized by the interplay between the classifier and the select relation.
